channel.title: Essays by Malory
channel.description: Essays on the male reader, boys and books, and the fiction that serves them — from Malory, Sci-Fi, LitRPG and Progression Fantasy author.

item.title: The One-Word Experiment
item.description: One word flipped the boys’ reading gap in a single afternoon. What stereotype threat says about the 2026 literacy panic.

item.title: The Age of Reading Isn’t Over. It’s Just Not Happening to Everyone.
item.description: The Atlantic says reading is dying for everyone. The data says the collapse is male and arrived a generation early — a reply to Rose Horowitch.

item.title: A Field Guide to the Performative Male Reader
item.description: The Performative Male Reader, catalogued — seven species, one blind spot, and the clandestine readers the whole panic keeps missing.

item.title: How to Manufacture a Man Who Doesn’t Read
item.description: A century of schools, stereotypes and tests built men who don’t dare read — and where boys’ reading actually went.

item.title: What You Told Me About Boys and Books
item.description: Reader responses on the boys-and-books question, and what the patterns in those responses reveal about how fiction lost its male audience.

item.title: The Curious Case of the Male Reader
item.description: What the data actually says about the male reading decline — and what it means for fiction.
